question: How many months are there in one whole year? 📅
explanation: Awesome! There are exactly 12 months in a year, starting from January and ending in December! 📆
hint: Think of the number on a clock face.

question: How many days make one full week? 🗓️
explanation: Great job! There are 7 days in a week, starting from Monday to Sunday. 🗓️
hint: Count the days on your fingers!

question: How many hours are in one whole day? ☀️
explanation: Super! A full day and night together make 24 hours. ☀️
hint: It is double the numbers on a clock.

question: How many minutes are in one single hour? ⏳
explanation: Fantastic! Every time 60 minutes pass, a whole new hour begins! ⏳

question: Which hand tells us the hours on a clock? ⏰
explanation: Brilliant! The short, thick hand points to the hour on the clock. ⏰

question: Which hand tells us the minutes on a clock? ⏱️
explanation: Awesome! The long hand moves around to show us the minutes! ⏱️
hint: It is longer than the hour hand.

question: What do we call the morning time before noon? 🌅
explanation: Great job! Morning time from midnight to noon is called AM. 🌅
hint: It starts with the first letter of the alphabet.

question: What do we call the afternoon and evening time? 🌇
explanation: Super! The time from noon until midnight is called PM. 🌇
hint: It starts with the letter P.

question: Which yummy meal do you eat in the AM? 🥞
explanation: Fantastic! Breakfast is the morning meal we eat to start our day! 🥞
hint: You eat this when you wake up.

question: When do you usually go to sleep at night? 🌙
explanation: Awesome! PM is for night time, so 9 PM is a perfect bedtime! 🌙

question: How many days are in a normal year? 🌍
explanation: Great job! It takes 365 days for the Earth to go around the Sun! 🌍
hint: It is a big number starting with a 3.

question: How many days are in a Leap Year? 🐸
explanation: Super! A Leap Year has one extra magical day, making it 366 days! 🐸
hint: It is just one more than a normal year.

question: Which special month has only 28 or 29 days? 💕
explanation: Brilliant! February is the shortest and cutest month of the year! 💕

question: What is the very first month of the year? 🎆
explanation: Awesome! We celebrate New Year in January, the first month! 🎆

question: What is the very last month of the year? 🎄
explanation: Great job! December brings the year to a happy close! 🎄

question: How many days are in January? ❄️
explanation: Fantastic! January is a long month with 31 whole days! ❄️

question: If it is 2:00 PM now, what time will it be in 1 hour? ⌚
explanation: Super! One hour after 2 is 3. The clock keeps ticking! ⌚

question: If it is 5:00 AM now, what time was it 2 hours ago? ⏰
explanation: Awesome! Subtracting 2 from 5 gives us 3 AM! ⏰

question: Which thin hand moves the fastest on a clock? 🏃
explanation: Brilliant! The second hand runs super fast around the clock! 🏃

question: Which month brings India's Independence Day? 🇮🇳
explanation: Great job! We celebrate Independence Day on the 15th of August! 🇮🇳

question: How often does a Leap Year come around? 🗓️
explanation: Super! We get to enjoy a Leap Year once every 4 years! 🗓️

question: How many weeks are there in one whole year? 📅
explanation: Fantastic! A full year is packed with 52 wonderful weeks! 📅
hint: It is a number in the 50s.

question: How many days are in 2 full weeks? 🗓️
explanation: Awesome! Since 1 week is 7 days, 2 weeks is 7 + 7 = 14 days! 🗓️

question: What is 30 minutes also known as? 🕒
explanation: Brilliant! 30 is exactly half of 60, so it is a half hour! 🕒
hint: It is a part of an hour.

question: What is 15 minutes also known as? 🕓
explanation: Great job! 15 minutes is a quarter of a full 60-minute hour! 🕓
hint: It is less than a half hour.

question: If today is Monday, what day is tomorrow? ☀️
explanation: Super! Tuesday comes right after Monday in the week! ☀️

question: If yesterday was Friday, what day is today? 🎈
explanation: Awesome! Friday is followed by the fun weekend day, Saturday! 🎈
hint: It is the start of the weekend.

question: Which month comes exactly after June? 🏖️
explanation: Fantastic! July follows June and brings more sunny days! 🏖️
hint: It also starts with a J.

question: Which month comes exactly before November? 🎃
explanation: Brilliant! October is the month right before November! 🎃

question: If a movie starts at 4 PM and ends at 6 PM, how long is it? 🍿
explanation: Great job! From 4 PM to 6 PM is exactly 2 hours of fun! 🍿

question: The minute hand points at 12 and hour hand points at 3. What time is it? 🕒
explanation: Super! When the big hand is on 12, it is the exact hour of the small hand! 🕒

question: The minute hand is at 6. The hour hand is between 1 and 2. What time is it? 🕜
explanation: Awesome! The minute hand on 6 means 30 minutes past 1. 🕜

question: How many days are in the month of June? ☔
explanation: Fantastic! June is one of the four months that has exactly 30 days! ☔

question: How many numbers are written around a normal clock face? 🔢
explanation: Brilliant! A clock has numbers from 1 all the way to 12! 🔢
hint: It matches the months in a year.

question: School starts at 8 AM and ends at 2 PM. How long are you at school? 🎒
explanation: Great job! From 8 AM to 12 PM is 4 hours, and 2 more hours makes 6! 🎒

question: What day of the week comes right after Saturday? 🌞
explanation: Super! Sunday is the relaxing day right after Saturday! 🌞

question: How many months in a year have exactly 31 days? 📅
explanation: Awesome! There are 7 big months in the year that have 31 days! 📅

question: When the sun is exactly above us in the sky, what time is it? ☀️
explanation: Fantastic! 12:00 PM during the daytime is called Noon! ☀️
hint: It happens in the middle of the day.

question: How many tiny seconds make up one minute? ⏱️
explanation: Brilliant! Just like minutes in an hour, there are 60 seconds in a minute! ⏱️
hint: It is the same as minutes in an hour.

question: Which of these months has exactly 30 days? 🍂
explanation: Great job! November is a cool month with exactly 30 days! 🍂

question: If your train leaves at 10 AM and takes 3 hours, when will you arrive? 🚂
explanation: Super! 10 + 3 hours takes you past 12 to 1 PM! 🚂

question: A leap year happens because the Earth takes extra time to go around the? 🌍
explanation: Awesome! The Earth travels around the Sun, creating our years! 🌍
hint: It is the big bright star in the day.

question: What number does the minute hand point to at 15 minutes past the hour? 🕒
explanation: Fantastic! Each number is 5 minutes. 5, 10, 15! So it points at 3. 🕒

question: What number does the minute hand point to at 45 minutes past the hour? 🕘
explanation: Brilliant! The minute hand points at 9 when it is 45 minutes! 🕘
hint: It is a quarter to the next hour.

question: If your birthday is exactly 1 week from today, how many days away is it? 🎂
explanation: Great job! One full week means you have 7 fun days to wait! 🎂
hint: It is the number of days in a week.

question: In which chilly month do we celebrate Christmas? 🎅
explanation: Super! Christmas is celebrated on the 25th of December! 🎅

question: Which hand is the shortest and thickest on a regular clock? ⏰
explanation: Awesome! The short and thick hand proudly tells us the hour! ⏰
hint: It points to the main numbers.

question: What day comes right in between Wednesday and Friday? 📆
explanation: Fantastic! Thursday perfectly sits right between Wednesday and Friday! 📆

question: If you study from 4 PM to 5 PM, how much time did you study? 📚
explanation: Brilliant! Going from 4 to 5 is exactly one hour of great studying! 📚
hint: The hour hand moved one number.

question: A normal year has 365 days. A Leap Year has how many extra days? 🐸
explanation: Great job! A Leap Year has exactly 1 extra day in February, making 366! 🐸
hint: It is the smallest counting number.
